spec_provided_observability.name: Performance counters (PortCounters)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-port error and traffic counters (symbol errors, link recovery, received/transmitted data + packets) read via GMP on QP1.

spec_provided_observability.name: Subnet Management attributes (PortInfo/NodeInfo)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read/write link width/speed, LID, VL caps, MTU, SL-to-VL, and forwarding tables via SMP on QP0.

spec_provided_observability.name: VCRC / ICRC
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-hop and end-to-end CRC detect packet corruption.

spec_provided_observability.name: PSN sequencing
spec_provided_observability.purpose: ACK/NAK by PSN exposes lost / out-of-sequence packets on reliable QPs.

spec_provided_observability.name: Subnet Administration (SA)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Query path records, service records, and topology for diagnostics.

error_detection_mechanisms: 16-bit Variant CRC (VCRC) checked at every hop.
PSN gap detection -> NAK + retransmission on reliable QPs.
Symbol / link-recovery error counters at the Physical Layer.
RNR NAK when the receiver has no posted Receive WQE.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: A WQE completes -> CQE posted to the CQ; optional CQ event/interrupt (solicited).
QP/CQ error, local protection error, path migration.

notes: InfiniBand's observability is in-band through Management Datagrams (SMPs on QP0, GMPs on QP1): PortCounters, PortInfo/NodeInfo, and Subnet Administration queries, complemented by the VCRC/ICRC and PSN ACK/NAK telemetry. Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST remain implementation concerns.
